# For each component, compute bounding box and fill ratio (roundness)
objs = ndi.find_objects(lbl)
roundish = []
elongated = []
for i, sl in enumerate(objs, start=1):
    h = sl[0].stop - sl[0].start
    w = sl[1].stop - sl[1].start
    area = sizes[i-1]
    if area < 5:  # ignore tiny noise
        continue
    fill = area / (h*w)
    aspect = max(h,w)/max(min(h,w),1)
    if aspect < 2.5 and fill > 0.4:
        roundish.append((i, area, h, w, round(fill,2), round(aspect,2)))
    else:
        elongated.append((i, area, h, w, round(fill,2), round(aspect,2)))
print("roundish count:", len(roundish), "total area:", sum(r[1] for r in roundish))

# compute Otsu threshold
total = part_vals.size
sum_all = np.sum(np.arange(256)*histv)
sumB = 0; wB = 0; max_var = -1; best_th = 0
for t in range(256):
    wB += histv[t]

    wF = total - wB

    mB = sumB/wB
    mF = (sum_all - sumB)/wF

    if var > max_var:
